An extreme race along endless and varied tracks, full of dangers and surprises awaits you!

Collect a huge collection of legendary cars and compete with friends and other players!

notes.title: Our new game is released! Check it out!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27141021/2c84de43ca463ce622b548c9e0bb72e790276261.jpg[/img]

The DIRECTED is a game in which you have to find the path to the goal, changing the direction of movement of your character. You have to overcome many traps and mechanisms to win. Closed doors, teleports, pressure plates and dilapidated platforms will challenge you. 50 different levels will test the strength of your logical thinking. Can you pass them all?

http://store.steampowered.com/app/781670/The_Directed/

notes.title: Polygon Attack Controller Update is live!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27141021/58eafe38d3f00c2717dfffddda19c42407408151.png[/img]


[h1][b]Bugs fixed:[/b][/h1]


[olist]
    [*][b]Fixed bug with switching music when exiting the pause menu[/b]


    [*][b]Fixed a bug where one of the bosses left a laser effect after death[/b]
[/olist]

[h1][b]Changes list:[/b][/h1]


[olist]
    [*][b]Added full support for XBox One and XBox 360 game controllers[/b]

    [*][b]Changed the upgrade screen, added controls hints for gamepad[/b]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27141021/714e790235961e76f8f4e2d80cd016eaa8cd4eec.png[/img]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27141021/ac253915ffd43fd37eed60b4624d991400226bcf.png[/img]


    [*][b]Added bonus descriptions[/b]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27141021/e6d3ef660d451a28b09e1e4c0512f1db751ba09c.png[/img]
